segments.say: Pact. The payment authorization gateway for A I agents. Let any agent shop for you, only within the limits you set.
segments.caption: PACT. The payment authorization gateway for AI agents.|Let any agent shop for you, only within the limits you set.

segments.say: A I agents can now shop for us. But to pay, we hand them a card with no limits. One injected prompt, and real money moves before anyone approves it.
segments.caption: AI agents can now shop for us.|But to pay, we hand them a card with no limits.|One injected prompt,|and real money moves before anyone approves it.

segments.say: Pact sits between any A I agent and PayPal. Agents can only ask. A deterministic policy engine authorizes, a human approves, and PayPal executes.
segments.caption: PACT sits between any AI agent and PayPal.|Agents can only ask.|A deterministic policy engine authorizes,|a human approves, and PayPal executes.

segments.say: It starts with a spending mandate. This one allows electronics from one merchant, up to one hundred dollars per purchase.
segments.caption: It starts with a spending mandate.|This one allows electronics from one merchant,|up to $100 per purchase.

segments.say: First, the built-in reference agent is asked for a keyboard that costs one hundred twenty-five dollars. Gemini recommends it.
segments.caption: First, the built-in reference agent is asked|for a keyboard that costs $125.|Gemini recommends it.

segments.say: Blocked. Attempted, one twenty-five. Allowed, one hundred. No approve button, no PayPal order. The A I cannot override the mandate.
segments.caption: Blocked. Attempted $125. Allowed $100.|No approve button, no PayPal order.|The AI cannot override the mandate.

segments.say: Next, an eighty-nine dollar keyboard passes all ten rules. But passing policy is not authorization.
segments.caption: Next, an $89 keyboard passes all ten rules.|But passing policy is not authorization.

segments.say: I review the budget impact and approve this exact purchase. My approval is sealed with a fingerprint.
segments.caption: I review the budget impact|and approve this exact purchase.|My approval is sealed with a fingerprint.

segments.say: A SHA-256 hash of the product, merchant, price, quantity, mandate rules and requesting agent. A forged approval is refused, and the hash is checked again before every PayPal step.
segments.caption: A SHA-256 hash of the product, merchant, price,|quantity, mandate rules and requesting agent.|A forged approval is refused,|and the hash is checked again before every PayPal step.

segments.say: Pact creates a real PayPal Sandbox order, and the buyer approves it in PayPal Checkout.
segments.caption: PACT creates a real PayPal Sandbox order,|and the buyer approves it in PayPal Checkout.

segments.say: Back in Pact, the server asks PayPal directly whether the buyer approved. Only then can the payment be captured.
segments.caption: Back in PACT, the server asks PayPal directly|whether the buyer approved.|Only then can the payment be captured.

segments.say: Captured. A real PayPal capture I D, status completed, for exactly eighty-nine dollars.
segments.caption: Captured.|A real PayPal capture ID, status COMPLETED,|for exactly $89.

segments.say: What if something changes after approval? I approve a second keyboard. Then the merchant raises the price.
segments.caption: What if something changes after approval?|I approve a second keyboard.|Then the merchant raises the price.

segments.say: The approval is void at once. A change can never silently inherit an old approval.
segments.caption: The approval is void at once.|A change can never silently inherit an old approval.

segments.say: Connecting an outside agent takes seconds. It gets one mandate and its own key, shown once and stored only as a hash.
segments.caption: Connecting an outside agent takes seconds.|It gets one mandate and its own key,|shown once and stored only as a hash.

segments.say: Claude, ChatGPT or your own agent use Pact's A P I or M C P server. Told money is no object, this Gemini agent still gets a no.
segments.caption: Claude, ChatGPT or your own agent|use PACT's API or MCP server.|Told money is no object,|this Gemini agent still gets a no.

segments.say: In-policy requests wait for you, and every step lands in the audit trail. Agents can ask. Only you approve.
segments.caption: In-policy requests wait for you,|and every step lands in the audit trail.|Agents can ask. Only you approve.

segments.say: And Pact isn't tied to one catalog. A Shopify-format store syncs in, and its offers face the same rules. This cable is blocked, because that store isn't on my mandate.
segments.caption: And PACT isn't tied to one catalog.|A Shopify-format store syncs in,|and its offers face the same rules.|This cable is blocked, because that store isn't on my mandate.

segments.say: Any platform plugs in with one connector that returns offers. The policy engine, the fingerprint and the PayPal flow never change.
segments.caption: Any platform plugs in with one connector that returns offers.|The policy engine, the fingerprint|and the PayPal flow never change.

segments.say: Agents request. The policy engine authorizes. A human approves. PayPal executes. Pact. The payment authorization gateway for A I agents.
segments.caption: Agents request. The policy engine authorizes.|A human approves. PayPal executes.|PACT. The payment authorization gateway for AI agents.
